operator: Exact rank-four moment update. Center each cell at its rational midpoint; certify the four-dimensional solve by directed polynomial Neumann residuals. Keep HOLD on failure.
classification: Exact order contradiction, certified weight-gap upper <=1/5, inherited fixed joint event, then best-Hellinger marginal or at most two fixed marginal CDF events. Every unproved cell remains HOLD.
refinement: Bisect widest HOLD cells first, then numeric binary path; never discard unresolved mass or step intervals.
stop: One fixed coupled spatial line, both signs, h in [-0.1,0.1]; 64 initial cells and at most 8*32 splits. No parameter retuning or extension after evaluating this contract. No other 58 paired rays or general stability claim.
freeze_note: Internal freeze before continuous evaluation; PR111 point results already known. Not external preregistration.
